mails.subject: Notice regarding membership no. 0482 and a question about a lost item
mails.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

I am writing on behalf of Nørrebro Fondsrådgivning ApS, which holds a flexible desk membership (no. 0482) at your space since February 2025.

Following an internal reorganisation, our team will work from the client's premises between 1 November and 28 February. Our management has therefore asked me to enquire whether your terms allow the membership to be paused for these four months, rather than terminated.

If a pause is not possible, please consider this email as a preliminary notice of termination, and kindly confirm the notice period that applies under our agreement and the date on which the final invoice would be issued.

We would be grateful to receive your written answer before the end of September, so that our finance department can update its forecast for the fourth quarter.

Separately, one of our colleagues believes he left a dark green thermos flask and a pair of reading glasses in the phone booth on the second floor, probably during the week of 7 September. May I ask whether anything of the kind has been handed in to the reception?

Thank you in advance for your assistance.

Yours faithfully,

Ingrid Vestergaard
Office Manager
Nørrebro Fondsrådgivning ApS
ingrid.vestergaard@norrebrofond.example
mails.justification: A member formally asks to pause or terminate a membership, expects a reply within the week, and mentions a lost item in passing.

mails.subject: Fwd: Proposition d'atelier chez vous en novembre ?
mails.body:
Salut, je pense que ça peut coller avec votre programme d'automne, tu peux répondre à Mathis directement ?

De : Mathis Perrin <mathis.perrin@collectif-sillage.example>
Objet : Proposition d'atelier en novembre

Bonjour,

Je suis animateur au sein du Collectif Sillage, nous organisons des ateliers de sérigraphie et de petite impression pour les indépendants. Nous cherchons un lieu à Copenhague pour une session de trois heures, un samedi de novembre, avec une douzaine de participants.

Seriez-vous ouverts à accueillir cet atelier dans votre espace ? Nous apportons tout le matériel. Pouvez-vous nous indiquer vos conditions et vos disponibilités ?

Cordialement,
Mathis Perrin

mails.subject: Torsdag: projektor og stole? 🙏
mails.body:
Hej begge to!

Vi holder Kodeklubbens efterårsmeetup på torsdag aften kl. 18, og vi er blevet flere end forventet. Lige nu står vi på 45 tilmeldte 🎉

Kan vi få flyttet fra det lille lokale til det store ved vinduerne? Ellers skal vi bruge mindst 15 ekstra stole.

Vi skal også bruge projektoren, en mikrofon til Q&A og en HDMI-adapter til USB-C, hvis I har en liggende. Jeg kommer og stiller op kl. 16.30, hvis det er okay.

Giv lige besked i morgen, så jeg kan skrive til deltagerne 😊

Mange hilsner
Mikkel

mails.subject: Renting a room for a day?
mails.body:
Hi there,

Sent from my phone so sorry for typos. Im Jonas, I run a small design studio with 4 people and we are looking for somewere to have an all-day planning session with the whole team, probly in the next month or two but I dont have a date yet.

Do you rent out meeting rooms by the day to people who are not members? And if yes how many people can the biggest room take, and is there a projector or a whiteboard we can use? We would also need coffee and maybe lunch if thats posible.

Also is there a price list somewhere on your site? I looked but could not find it.

Its not urgent at all, we just want to know if its an option before we decide.

Thanks a lot
Jonas Berg
Studio Berg
+45 55 01 22 34
Sent from my iPhone

mails.subject: Sponsorship proposal for your autumn community events
mails.body:
Hello,

I am the partnerships lead at GreenLoop Network, a Copenhagen non-profit that promotes reuse and repair among small businesses.

We would like to propose a sponsoring arrangement for your autumn community events. We would contribute 12,000 DKK towards refreshments and print material, and in return we would ask for our logo on your event pages and a short mention at each event.

We could also write a short article about your space for our members' newsletter.

If this is of interest, I would be glad to set up a call in the coming weeks to discuss details.

Kind regards,
Elena Marchetti
GreenLoop Network

mails.subject: Demande de rectification de la facture n° 2026-0731
mails.body:
Madame, Monsieur,

Nous avons bien reçu votre facture n° 2026-0731 d'un montant de 1 250 EUR, relative à nos postes de travail du mois de septembre.

Cette facture ne mentionne pas notre numéro de TVA intracommunautaire (FR 12 345 678 901), qui est obligatoire pour sa comptabilisation. Nous vous prions de bien vouloir émettre une facture rectifiée comportant cette mention.

Merci de nous la faire parvenir dans les meilleurs délais, notre clôture mensuelle approchant.

Veuillez agréer, Madame, Monsieur, l'expression de nos salutations distinguées.

Claire Delmas
Responsable comptabilité, Maison Delmas SAS

mails.subject: The Coworking Digest, October edition
mails.body:
Hello and welcome to the October edition of The Coworking Digest, the monthly round-up you signed up for.

THIS MONTH IN SHARED WORKSPACES

1. Quiet hours are back. Several spaces in northern Europe are trying out two silent blocks per day, from 9 to 11 and from 14 to 16. Early reports suggest members like it, and phone booth queues get shorter.

2. Pricing trends. A survey of 140 flexible workspaces shows desk prices rising about 4 percent over the last year, while meeting room hire has stayed flat.

3. Community managers speak. We interviewed three managers about what keeps members coming back. The common answer: regular small events beat big occasional ones.

TOOLS WE LIKE

A free floor plan tool for planning room layouts, and a simple shared calendar for equipment loans.

UPCOMING DATES

- 14 October: online meetup for community managers
- 29 October: webinar on running a good members' lunch

That is all for this month. See you in November.

You receive this newsletter because you subscribed at cowork-digest.example. Unsubscribe at any time using the link in your account settings.

The Coworking Digest team
mails.justification: A subscribed monthly newsletter, with nothing to reply to and no action needed.
